abilities.name: Universal Diagnosis
_curatorNotes: Skill heal authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10 as a single onCast (skill) team heal. gcsim skill.go skillHealing(): Player.Heal with Target -1 (all party members) → target 'team' (kit: 'healing all nearby party members'). Fires once after the Gossamer Sprite's attack chain completes and it returns (skillReturnTravel=51 frames after the last chain hit, or immediately via chain() when no enemy is found); represented as onCast since the schema has no delayed-single-heal trigger, so the return-travel delay is a timing simplification. TL10: skillHealPP[9]=0.144 (14.4% Max HP) + skillHealFlat[9]=1694.9546 (sidecar 'Healing' 10th column '14.40% Max HP+1695'). gcsim indexes the skill-heal arrays with TalentLvlBurst() — a gcsim quirk; at TL10 both talent indexers resolve to index 9, and in-game the heal scales with the Universal Diagnosis (Skill) talent.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Clause 1 restates a tool-wide behaviour — no heal effect draws anywhere in the planner for any character (no timeline module consumes 'heal'), so nothing on screen claims otherwise and no Baizhu-specific divergence exists. Clause 2 ('lands when the Sprite returns…') is kit explanation of a heal that has no bar to be mis-timed. If Nate wants heal visibility it is one tool-level line, not 123 per-character caveats. Category: invisible-omission.
abilities.description:
Controls a Gossamer Sprite that cruises and attacks nearby opponents, dealing Dendro DMG.
After it performs 3 attacks or if there are no opponents nearby, the Sprite will return, healing all nearby party members based on Baizhu's Max HP.

abilities.name: Holistic Revivification

_curatorNotes: Spiritvein DMG authored 2026-08-17 as a summonTick damage effect on the Pulsing Clarity summon (it was the 'remains unauthored' finding in the note above). gcsim burst.go summonSpiritvein(): AttackInfo Element Dendro, Durability 25 (1U), ICDTag attacks.ICDTagNone → trigger icdGate 'none' (gcsim-frames-diff §5 measured 5/5 'none'). Mult burstAtk[9] = 1.747152 → scaling 174.7152, ATK-scaling (no snap/HP modification; sidecar 'Spiritvein DMG' 10th column '174.7%').

Cadence from gcsim burst.go Burst(): shields are summoned at frames 81 and burstFirstShield+burstFirstRefresh+burstRefreshRate*i = 223/369/515/661/807. summonSeamlessShield() fires summonSpiritvein() only when a shield already exists, so the first shield (81) produces none and the 5 refreshes do — interval burstRefreshRate 146f = 2.433s. QueueAttack lands the hit at burstTickRelease+burstTickTravel = 21+8 = 29f after the refresh, so the first Spiritvein lands at 223+29 = 252f = 4.2s from cast; Pulsing Clarity spawnsAt = 0, so firstTickDelay = 4.2. Matches the measured row (252f / 146f × 5).

Not modelled: the 6th Spiritvein from shield.go removeShield() (OnExpire/OnDamage-break) — the final shield expires at 807+burstShieldExpiry 152 = 959f ≈ 16.0s, outside the authored 14s window, and a shatter-triggered one has no fixed timing. C6 adds FlatDmg = 8% Max HP to each Spiritvein (already stubbed on the C6 node); it changes neither the cadence nor the tick count, so one C0 series is authored.

Generator had behavior: 'stance' — changed to 'instant'. The burst does not replace normals/charge. It creates a 14s Pulsing Clarity state that generates periodic Seamless Shields: first at frame 81 (burstFirstShield=81), then 5 more at burstFirstRefresh=142 + burstRefreshRate=146 intervals. Each shield has burstShieldExpiry=152 frame lifespan (~2.5s). Spiritvein DMG fires when a new shield is generated on top of an existing one, or when a shield expires/shatters. Duration 14s taken from genshin-db (gcsim has no explicit duration constant). Seamless Shield (shield window) and Seamless Shield Healing are now authored (see below); Spiritvein DMG remains unauthored (separate finding — it would be a `damage` effect fired on shield-refresh-over-existing and on shield expiry/shatter; C6 adds +8% Max HP FlatDmg, already stubbed on the C6 node).

Seamless Shield authored 2026-07-12 as a single onCast (burst) shield window covering the 14s Pulsing Clarity state (canonical shield-window shape per the onShieldEnd derivation: Effect.type 'shield' + onCast + explicit duration). gcsim shield.go newShield(): Target -1 (party-wide, protects the on-field character) → target 'active'; Element Dendro. TL10 per-shield absorption: burstShieldPP[9]=0.0144 (1.44% Max HP) + burstShieldFlat[9]=169.4954 (sidecar 'Seamless Shield DMG Absorption' 10th column '1.44% Max HP+169'). duration 14 represents the continuous-coverage window (first shield at frame 81≈1.35s, regenerated every burstRefreshRate=146f≈2.43s, each lasting burstShieldExpiry=152f≈2.53s); the onCast window starts at cast rather than frame 81 (a ~1.35s timing simplification) and the per-shield amount refreshes rather than stacks (durationType 'fixed'). 250% Dendro DMG absorption effectiveness not modelled — no per-element shield-efficiency primitive (same gap class as Diona/Thoma/Kaeya).

Seamless Shield Healing authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick heal on the Pulsing Clarity summon. gcsim burst.go summonSeamlessShieldHealing(): Player.Heal Target c.Core.Player.Active() → target 'active' (heals only the on-field character; kit: 'heal your own active character'). Heals fire on the 5 shield refreshes (NOT the first shield — gcsim comment 'no heal on first shield') at frames 223/369/515/661/807 (burstFirstShield 81 + burstFirstRefresh 142 + burstRefreshRate 146×i, i=0..4): interval 146f≈2.43s, first heal 223f≈3.72s from cast (Pulsing Clarity spawnsAt=0). With duration 14 this yields 5 ticks (3.72/6.15/8.58/11.02/13.45s), matching gcsim's 5 refresh heals; a 6th expiry heal (removeShield on the final shield's expiry ~16s) falls outside the summon window and is not rendered. Kit rounds the regen cadence to 'every 2.5s'. TL10: burstHealPP[9]=0.0936 (9.36% Max HP) + burstHealFlat[9]=1101.7205 (sidecar 'Seamless Shield Healing' 10th column '9.36% Max HP+1102').

Shield label "Seamless Shield" taken verbatim from this ability's own description text (the game's wording, via genshin-db) — the shield lane renders it. ⛔ Kits whose text says only "a shield" (Diona, Candace, Xinyan, Lan Yan) keep the generic fallback rather than borrowing the ability name; gcsim's "<Ability> (Shield)" strings are its own internal convention, not in-game names.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Kept half: the shield lane draws ONE unbroken 14s bar where the game issues ~6 successive Seamless Shields, each replacing the last — and the Pulsing Clarity summon row directly beside it is ticking at 2.43s, so the smooth bar visibly disagrees with the marks next to it. Killed half: 'the much stronger Dendro absorption' is the Nicole case verbatim — every elemental shield absorbs its own element at 250%, no shield in the tool shows absorption, so nothing on screen looks wrong. Category: approximation-disclosure.

nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim baizhu/burst.go: shield + heal tasks; Spiritvein fires from a shield REFRESH (≈f252), which the Pulsing Clarity series carries.
abilities.description:
Enters the Pulsing Clarity state, creating a Seamless Shield that absorbs Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
While in this state, Baizhu will generate a new Seamless Shield every 2.5s.

The Seamless Shield will heal your own active character based on Baizhu's Max HP and attack opponents by unleashing Spiritveins, dealing Dendro DMG under the following circumstances:
·When a character is under the protection of a Seamless Shield and a new Seamless Shield is generated.
·When the Seamless Shield's effects expire, or when it is shattered.

passives.name: Five Fortunes Forever
_curatorNotes: Migrated to passive trigger 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim registers permanent stat mods that evaluate active character HP ratio at runtime; the planner doesn't track per-segment HP, so the HP-conditional gating isn't enforced — the +25% dendroDmgBonus branch always renders. Healing Bonus branch (HP < 50%) intentionally not authored as a second effect to avoid double-rendering.
passives.description:
Baizhu gains different effects according to the current HP of your current active character:
·When their HP is less than 50%, Baizhu gains 20% Healing Bonus.
·When their HP is equal to or more than 50%, Baizhu gains 25% Dendro DMG Bonus.

passives.name: All Things Are of the Earth
passives.caveat: Not modeled: for 6s after being healed by the burst's Seamless Shields, a character deals up to 100% more Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG and up to 40% more Aggravate and Spread DMG.
_curatorNotes: Year of Verdant Favor scales with Baizhu's Max HP (cap 50,000): per 1,000 HP, Burning/Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon reaction DMG +2% (max +100%), Aggravate/Spread DMG Bonus +0.8% (max +40%), Lunar-Bloom +0.7%; lasts 6s. Real trigger is 'healed by Seamless Shield' (gcsim baizhu/asc.go:51-80 — a4 fires inside summonSeamlessShieldHealing), target = the healed character.

Value-less self allDmgBonus generator artifact removed 2026-07-28 (capability sweep): it carried no value, the wrong trigger (onReaction:burning), and the wrong target (self). Not re-authorable, and team allDmgBonus would grossly overstate a reaction-only bonus. Caveated instead.

↻ 2026-08-18 (stale-note pass) — the STAT half of the reasoning above is stale; the conclusion (not authorable, caveat instead) still stands, but on ONE blocker rather than three. The old text read "the Stat union has no bloom-family reaction DMG-bonus keys (Tier-2 reaction schema frozen)". Both clauses are dead: Tier-2 was UNFROZEN and largely cleared, and the faction-buffs round (2026-07-29, Nate's bucket-5 ruling) added the Reaction Bonus stat family — `bloomReactionBonus` and `lunarBloomReactionBonus` both exist now (src/lib/types/ability.ts:141-148), so two of the five families this A4 grants ARE expressible today. Still missing as Stat keys: burning, hyperbloom and burgeon Reaction Bonus, plus any aggravate/spread bonus — those five names exist only as `Reaction` union members (ability.ts:41-84), never as `Stat`.

↻ 2026-08-18 — ⛔ THE BLOCKER THAT ACTUALLY HOLDS IS THE TRIGGER, and it is unchanged: the real gate is "healed by a Seamless Shield" (gcsim baizhu/asc.go:51-80, a4 inside summonSeamlessShieldHealing). `onHeal` is declared (ability.ts:643-655) with ZERO evaluators and ZERO corpus authors, so nothing could fire it. ⛔ `manual` is not a fallback either — grep for `'manual'` across src/lib and src/routes returns exactly ONE line, the type declaration at ability.ts:649; the 167 manual-trigger effects across 69 characters reach no planner surface at all, and the style guide's old "add it manually" lesson is FALSE. ⏭ WORK ITEM, once a heal-triggered primitive exists: three new Stat keys (burning/hyperbloom/burgeon Reaction Bonus) plus an aggravate/spread bonus key, then a `target: 'active'` buff on that trigger with the per-1,000-Max-HP scaling recorded in the note above. Until then the caveat is the only honest surface.
passives.description: Characters who are healed by Seamless Shields will gain the Year of Verdant Favor effect: Each 1,000 Max HP that Baizhu possesses that does not exceed 50,000 will increase the Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG dealt by these characters by 2%, their Lunar-Bloom DMG by 0.7%, and the DMG Bonus provided by Aggravate and Spread by 0.8%. This effect lasts 6s.

constellations.name: Incisive Discernment
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. Likely onHit (OnEnemyDamage) filtered to active character; 5s ICD (gcsim: c2ICDKey 60*5=300 frames). Gossamer Sprite: Splice is ElementalSkill DMG, 250% ATK, Dendro. Also includes C2 healing (20% of Universal Diagnosis heal amount, not authored as effect).

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2: Incisive Discernment — effects[0] (damage, 250% `atk`, dendro) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `cons.go:25-74` — a permanent `OnEnemyDamage` subscription registered at character init, gated only on "the hit's actor is the active character" and a 300f (5s) status; it is bound to no cast and no summon, so there is no window to arm a listener from. Retained: the measurements, since the damage is deleted and they are the only record: `ICDTagElementalArt` / `ICDGroupBaizhuC2`, Durability 25 (1U), Mult 2.5, hit reusing `skillFirstHitmark`, 5s ICD (`c2ICDKey`), and — the load-bearing part — that the proc registry can only arm from a cast (`armedFor`) or a summon's liveness (`sim/procs.ts` `armCastProcs`/`armSummonProcs`), while this listener is permanent, so no `application[]` could ever be dispatched. ⚠️ ⚓ The C2's HEAL half is a separate, genuinely authorable claim this round leaves on the table — a `heal` effect reaches a real facet chip, badge and coverage row in the Team Builder (`effectCapability` maps `heal`; only `damage` maps to nothing). `20% of Universal Diagnosis's heal` at TL10 = `0.2 × (14.4% Max HP + 1694.9546)`:
constellations.description:
When your own active character hits a nearby opponent with their attacks, Baizhu will unleash a Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
Gossamer Sprite: Splice will initiate 1 attack before returning, dealing 250% of Baizhu's ATK as Dendro DMG and healing for 20% of Universal Diagnosis's Gossamer Sprite's normal healing.
DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
